metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Dizzyobeah

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Classifies each prompt and routes it to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus (or locks it to one, Fable and Mythos included), with /route for model and effort and a live route and savings band above the prompt

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Session, daily and weekly usage in a Powerline band above the prompt, stacked with other bands, with /usage-band to turn it on, and click it or /usage-band pane for a live per-model and per-agent pane
